400 Bad Request when creating a batch with invalid input file

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import CreateBatchRequest
from liter_llm import Error

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        request = CreateBatchRequest.from_json("{\"completion_window\":\"24h\",\"endpoint\":\"/v1/chat/completions\",\"input_file_id\":\"file-wrong-purpose\"}")
        await client.create_batch(request)
    except Error as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
